Arabic Program

Weekly virtual Arabic classes for adults, run with a Palestinian partner college: a conversational track in the Palestinian dialect and a traditional reading and writing track.

Who it's for

AFRP members, with placement help for level and track. On the Education branch it is the one rung open at any age.

The operating year

Six-week virtual mini-courses on Saturdays, plus summer enrichment courses. Term dates are not stated in the record.

The five rungs

Not stated in the record for this programme. The five rungs are hear, show up, take part, give or serve, and lead (D25).

Who runs it

The Arabic Program Committee, a standing committee joined through the Committee Interest Form. What it escalates is not stated.

Money

AFRP, fee-funded or general fund. Instructor costs go to the partner college; figures are not stated.

Hand-offs

Open at any age, so no milestone invitation fires into it. The prototype links it to Camp, the Preservation Project and the magazine's Arabic pages.
